items.title: 中國7月出口成長23.9% 但增速放緩
items.title_en: China's July Exports Grow 23.9%, but Growth Slows
paras: 儘管 7 月增速放緩，中國進出口仍保持強勁成長步伐，主要受惠於全球人工智慧（AI）領域超級投資周期抵銷了極端天氣對貿易的干擾。
中國海關總署 7 日（周五）公布的數據顯示，以美元計，7 月出口成長 23.9%，高於經濟學家預估的 23% 中位數，但低於上月 27% 的增幅。進口增長 27.5%，貿易順差達到 1,125 億美元。
AI 相關電子產品以及電動車等其他尖端產品的海外出貨量激增，減緩了今年經濟更深幅度放緩。然而，貿易榮景也加劇了經濟內部長期存在的失衡——國內需求依然疲軟，這降低了中國官方增強國內消費者支持力道的必要性。
中國企業在全球價值鏈中主導地位提升，也導致其與歐美國家的緊張關係加劇，特別是在電動車製造業以及最近的資料中心硬體領域。
中國海關總署說，中國有完整產業體系、超大規模市場、強大創新能力、良好營商環境，為各類外貿經營主體提供開放合作創新發展的沃土。
海關總署稱，前七個月，民營企業外貿主力軍地位穩固，外商投資企業進出口增速領先，國有企業進出口同步增長，呈現了並駕齊驅、齊頭並進的局面。
今年前七個月，中國以水路、航空、公路、鐵路運輸方式進出口分別增長 6.9%、34.6%、40.7%、17.2%。隨著中國國際運輸通道體系不斷健全，跨境貨物運輸更加便捷高效，外貿企業的選擇更趨多元靈活。
paras_en: Despite a slowdown in July, China's imports and exports continued to grow strongly, mainly due to the super investment cycle in the global artificial intelligence (AI) field offsetting the disruption to trade caused by extreme weather.

According to data released by China's General Administration of Customs on Friday, exports in July grew 23.9% in dollar terms, higher than the median forecast of 23% by economists, but lower than the 27% growth in the previous month. Imports increased 27.5%, with a trade surplus of $112.5 billion.

The surge in overseas shipments of AI-related electronic products and other cutting-edge products such as electric vehicles has mitigated a deeper slowdown in the economy this year. However, the trade boom has also exacerbated the long-standing imbalance in the economy - domestic demand remains weak, reducing the need for the Chinese government to boost domestic consumer support.

The rising dominance of Chinese companies in the global value chain has also led to increased tensions with European and American countries, particularly in the electric vehicle manufacturing industry and the recent data center hardware sector.

The General Administration of Customs said that China has a complete industrial system, a huge market, strong innovation capabilities, and a good business environment, providing an open and cooperative platform for innovative development for all types of foreign trade operators.

The customs authority stated that in the first seven months, private enterprises maintained their position as the main force in foreign trade, while foreign-invested enterprises led in import and export growth, and state-owned enterprises saw synchronized growth, presenting a scene of joint development.

In the first seven months of this year, China's imports and exports via water, air, highway, and railway transportation grew 6.9%, 34.6%, 40.7%, and 17.2%, respectively. As China's international transportation system continues to improve, cross-border cargo transportation has become more convenient and efficient, providing more diverse and flexible options for foreign trade companies.

items.title: 伊朗-阿曼荷姆茲海峽新規意味著什麼？航運業者陷兩難：不能不付 但也不能付
items.title_en: What does the new Iran-Oman Hormuz Strait rule mean? Shipping industry caught in a bind: can't pay but can't not pay
paras: 伊朗週四 (6 日) 公佈荷姆茲海峽航運管理限制性草案，打算與阿曼聯手管控經該峽進入波斯灣的船隻，德黑蘭擬對過往船舶課貨物價值 5%-7%「服務費」，阿曼討論收取約 3%，華府則要求全免。草案同步設立受美制裁的「波斯灣海峽管理局」營運收費，讓合規問題瞬間炸開。
八大國際航運協會 (BIMCO、ICS、INTERTANKO、INTERCARGO、CLIA、ECSA、ASA、WSC) 本週聯名致函聯合國與國際海事組織(IMO)，強調商船於國際水道「安全、可預測、不受不必要阻礙航行」是供應鏈韌性與能源安全底線，強制收費將開惡例，破壞用於國際航行的海峽法律框架。
保險端已先動手。勞合社市場協會 (LMA) 上月底新增條款：船舶若付荷姆茲過路費、通行費或任何類似費用，保單即終止。
業內人士直言，船舶業者陷入不付恐被伊朗攔檢、付了觸犯美制裁且保險失效的兩難境地。
市場憂心費用轉嫁推高油運、液化天然氣 (LNG) 與散貨成本，進而滲透至能源與大宗商品終端價。
伊阿兩國這份「不能不付、也不能付」的草案，短期是外交籌碼，長期卻把荷姆茲從軍事風險升級為「法律—保險—制裁」的航運雷區。
paras_en: Iran announced on Thursday (6th) a draft of the Hormuz Strait shipping management restrictions, planning to jointly control ships entering the Persian Gulf through the strait with Oman. Tehran plans to charge a 'service fee' of 5-7% of the cargo value for past ships, while Oman is discussing a charge of around 3%, and Washington is demanding exemption. The draft also establishes a 'Persian Gulf Strait Management Bureau' operated by the US-sanctioned entity, which has sparked controversy over compliance issues.

Eight major international shipping associations (BIMCO, ICS, INTERTANKO, INTERCARGO, CLIA, ECSA, ASA, WSC) jointly wrote to the United Nations and the International Maritime Organization (IMO) this week, emphasizing that commercial ships on international waterways should have 'safety, predictability, and no unnecessary obstacles' to navigation, which is the bottom line for supply chain resilience and energy security. Forcing charges would set a bad precedent and destroy the legal framework for straits used for international navigation.

The insurance side has already taken action. The London Market Association (LMA) added a clause last month: if a ship pays the Hormuz transit fee, toll, or any similar fee, the policy will be terminated.
Industry insiders say that shipping companies are caught in a bind between not paying and risking Iranian inspection, paying and violating US sanctions, and losing insurance coverage.
The market is worried that the cost of paying the fee will be passed on to oil, liquefied natural gas (LNG), and bulk cargo, ultimately seeping into energy and commodity terminal prices.

The 'can't pay but can't not pay' draft from Iran and Oman is a short-term diplomatic bargaining chip, but in the long term, it upgrades the Hormuz Strait from a military risk to a 'legal-insurance-sanctions' shipping minefield.

items.title: AI及BBU訂單放量助攻 邑昇7月營收1.85億元創歷史新高
items.title_en: Yi Sheng's 7M Revenue Hits NT$185M, a New High
paras: 已加入半導體國家隊的 PCB 廠邑昇 (5291-TW) 公布最新營收資訊 ，2026 年 7 月營收達 1.85 億元創新高，月增 51.12%，年增 43.54%，1-7 月營收 8.99 億元，年增 43.54%。同時，邑昇上半年稅後淨利 3667 萬元，每股純益 0.92 元
邑昇 7 月營收創高主要受惠於 AI 應用持續快速發展，帶動周邊設備規格全面升級，高階 PCB 需求明顯增溫，其中 AI 伺服器備援電池模組（BBU）相關產品於 7 月進入放量出貨階段，成為推升單月營收創高的主要動能。
隨著 AI 伺服器朝高功率、高密度方向發展，BBU 對 PCB 在高可靠度、高層數、高散熱及高精密製程的要求同步提升，也進一步凸顯邑昇在少量多樣、高度客製化 PCB 製造的技術優勢。公司目前與國內主要客戶維持長期穩定合作關係，除持續供應既有產品外，亦同步投入多項新產品開發，為後續營運成長奠定基礎。

從產品結構來看，邑昇今年上半年 PCB 出貨仍以工業電腦應用為主要營收來源，受惠 AI 功能持續導入工控、自動化及邊緣運算設備，帶動工業電腦產品規格升級，高階 PCB 需求穩健成長。另一方面，公司近年積極布局 AI、高速運算、低軌衛星（LEO）、無人機及終端反無人機設備等高技術門檻市場，相關產品上半年營收占比已突破雙位數，預期隨客戶專案陸續放量，高毛利產品比重將持續提升，目標 2027 年高附加價值產品營收占比較目前倍數成長，進一步優化產品組合與獲利能力。
邑昇長期聚焦少量多樣、高度客製化之利基型 PCB 市場，並因應全球供應鏈重組趨勢，生產基地皆集中於台灣桃園，可有效滿足國際客戶對非紅色供應鏈及在地製造的需求。同時，吧昇已於 2025 年 10 月正式取得 AS9100 航太品質管理系統認證，代表品質管理體系已全面接軌國際航太標準，除有助於拓展低軌衛星及航太供應鏈商機，也將持續提升公司在高可靠度 PCB 市場的競爭優勢。
因應高階產品需求快速成長，邑昇龜山二期廠現已進入最後驗收階段，預計第三季末正式啟用並開始貢獻營收，新廠將整合既有 PCB 產能，導入高精密製程設備、自動化智慧產線及數位化製程管理系統，全面提升生產效率、品質管理及交期能力，為 AI、高速運算、航太及軍工等高附加價值產品提供更充足的產能支援。
paras_en: Yi Sheng (5291-TW), a PCB manufacturer that has joined the semiconductor national team, announced its latest revenue information. In July 2026, the company's revenue reached NT$1.85 billion, a new high, with a monthly increase of 51.12% and a year-over-year increase of 43.54%. The company's revenue for the first seven months of the year was NT$8.99 billion, with a year-over-year increase of 43.54%. Meanwhile, Yi Sheng's net profit after tax for the first half of the year was NT$36.67 million, with a net profit per share of NT$0.92.

Yi Sheng's 7M revenue growth was mainly driven by the rapid development of AI applications, which has led to a significant upgrade in peripheral equipment specifications, resulting in a surge in demand for high-end PCBs. The company's BBU-related products entered the mass production stage in July, becoming the main driving force behind the company's single-month revenue growth.

As AI servers move towards high-power and high-density development, BBU has raised the bar for PCBs in terms of high reliability, high layer count, high heat dissipation, and high precision processing. This has further highlighted Yi Sheng's technical advantages in producing small-batch, high-variety, and highly customized PCBs. The company currently maintains long-term stable cooperation relationships with major domestic customers, providing existing products while simultaneously investing in the development of new products to lay the foundation for future growth.

From a product structure perspective, Yi Sheng's PCB shipments in the first half of the year still relied mainly on industrial computer applications, benefiting from the continued introduction of AI functions into industrial control, automation, and edge computing equipment, driving the upgrade of industrial computer products and steady growth in high-end PCB demand. On the other hand, the company has been actively expanding into AI, high-speed computing, low-Earth orbit (LEO), unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), and terminal anti-UAV equipment markets with high technical thresholds. The related products accounted for a double-digit percentage of the company's revenue in the first half of the year, and it is expected that as customer projects are gradually put into mass production, the proportion of high-margin products will continue to rise, aiming to achieve a growth of multiple times in 2027 compared to the current year, further optimizing the product mix and profitability.

Yi Sheng has long focused on the niche market of small-batch, high-variety, and highly customized PCBs, and in response to the trend of global supply chain reorganization, all of its production bases are concentrated in Taoyuan, Taiwan, effectively meeting the needs of international customers for non-red supply chains and local manufacturing. Additionally, Yi Sheng officially obtained the AS9100 aerospace quality management system certification in October 2025, representing that the quality management system has been fully aligned with international aerospace standards. This not only helps to expand opportunities in the LEO and aerospace supply chain but also continues to enhance the company's competitive advantage in the high-reliability PCB market.

In response to the rapid growth of high-end product demand, Yi Sheng's Guaishan Phase II factory has entered the final inspection stage and is expected to be officially put into operation by the end of the third quarter, contributing to revenue. The new factory will integrate existing PCB production capacity, introduce high-precision processing equipment, automated intelligent production lines, and digitalized process management systems, comprehensively improving production efficiency, quality management, and delivery capabilities, providing more abundant production capacity support for AI, high-speed computing, aerospace, and military products with high added value.

items.title: 台普威Q2獲利翻倍、EPS 3.6元 擬買回庫藏股600張
items.title_en: TPW Energy Q2 Profit Doubles, EPS 3.6 NTD, Plans to Repurchase 600 Shares
paras: 雲豹能源 (6869-TW) 旗下儲能子公司台普威能源 (7921-TW) 召開董事會，通過 2026 年第二季財務報告、盈餘分配案及庫藏股案。受惠海外儲能相關收入大幅成長，台普威上半年合併營收達新台幣 11.09 億元，稅後淨利 1.45 億元，年增 102.9%，每股盈餘 (EPS) 為 3.6 元，獲利表現亮眼。
同時，董事會亦決議自 2026 年 8 月 6 日至 10 月 5 日辦理庫藏股買回，預計買回普通股 600 張，買回價格區間為每股 72 元至 120 元；若股價低於買回價格區間下限，公司仍將持續執行買回。買回股份將轉讓予員工，藉此強化人才激勵與團隊向心力，並展現公司對長期營運發展及企業價值的信心。
隨著海外儲能布局效益逐步顯現，台普威上半年毛利率由去年同期 11% 大幅提升至 34%，創歷史新高；營業利益達 2.12 億元，年增 93.7%，顯示海外業務成長已逐步轉化為實質獲利成果。
台普威總經理馮浩翔表示，今年上半年營運動能主要來自海外市場，其中日本市場營收達新台幣 7.89 億元，占整體營收逾 7 成。台普威近年積極拓展日本儲能市場，目前已有逾 13 座案場完成併網，2026 年預計裝置容量達 58MW / 231MWh，除持續推進高壓案件外，亦擴展至低壓及特高壓儲能市場，逐步擴大當地建置規模及收入組合。
除日本市場外，台普威近期亦啟動澳洲市場布局，目前已掌握 128MW / 292MWh 開發案量，預計於今、明兩年陸續完工。同時持續開發歐洲、北美等具成長潛力的海外市場，以台灣經驗建立跨國實績，推動海外事業成為未來營收與獲利的重要成長引擎。
在股東回饋方面，董事會通過 2025 年度盈餘分配案，每股擬配發現金股利 2.53 元，與股東共享營運成果。
展望下半年，台普威將持續推進日本及澳洲儲能專案，並積極布局 AI 資料中心 (AIDC) 等新興市場，延續「實績先行、由小到大」策略，逐步擴大應用規模，以自主 EMS、系統整合及工程建置能力，掌握 AIDC 對穩定供電與能源管理的需求。
paras_en: TPW Energy (7921-TW), a subsidiary of Cloud Leopard Energy (6869-TW), held a board meeting to approve the 2026 second-quarter financial report, profit distribution plan, and treasury stock plan. Benefiting from significant growth in overseas energy storage-related income, TPW Energy's first-half consolidated revenue reached NT$11.09 billion, net profit after tax of NT$1.45 billion, a year-on-year increase of 102.9%, and an EPS of 3.6 NTD, with outstanding performance.

The board of directors also decided to conduct a treasury stock repurchase from August 6 to October 5, 2026, with a plan to repurchase 600 common shares at a price range of NT$72 to NT$120 per share. If the stock price is below the lower limit of the price range, the company will continue to execute the repurchase. The repurchased shares will be transferred to employees to enhance talent motivation and team cohesion, and to demonstrate the company's confidence in long-term operation development and corporate value.

As the benefits of overseas energy storage layout gradually emerge, TPW Energy's first-half gross margin rose significantly from 11% in the same period last year to 34%, a new historical high. Operating profit reached NT$2.12 billion, a year-on-year increase of 93.7%, indicating that overseas business growth has gradually turned into tangible profit results.

TPW Energy's General Manager, Feng Hao-Xiang, stated that the company's revenue in the first half of the year mainly came from overseas markets, with Japan's revenue reaching NT$7.89 billion, accounting for over 7% of the company's total revenue. TPW Energy has been actively expanding the Japanese energy storage market in recent years and has completed over 13 project connections. In 2026, the company expects to install 58MW/231MWh of capacity, in addition to continuing to push high-voltage cases, it has also expanded to low-voltage and high-voltage energy storage markets, gradually expanding its local scale and income composition.

In addition to the Japanese market, TPW Energy has recently launched its layout in the Australian market, with a current development volume of 128MW/292MWh. The company expects to complete the projects in the next two years. At the same time, it continues to develop other overseas markets with growth potential, such as Europe and North America, to establish cross-border achievements with Taiwan's experience and drive overseas business to become an important engine for future revenue and profit growth.

Regarding shareholder returns, the board of directors approved the 2025 dividend distribution plan, with a proposed cash dividend of NT$2.53 per share, sharing the company's operating results with shareholders.

Looking ahead to the second half of the year, TPW Energy will continue to push forward Japanese and Australian energy storage projects and actively layout AI data centers (AIDC) and other emerging markets, continuing the 'results-driven, from small to large' strategy, gradually expanding the application scale, and mastering AIDC's demand for stable power supply and energy management with its autonomous EMS, system integration, and engineering construction capabilities.

items.title: 核心業務與手收發威！彰銀前7月賺134.92億創同期高 EPS衝上1.12元
items.title_en: Chang Hwa Bank Posts NT$134.92 Billion in Profit for First 7 Months, Highest in Same Period
paras: 彰銀 (2801-TW) 今公布 2026 年 7 月份自結合併稅前盈餘 24.09 億元，合併稅後盈餘 21.78 億元，年增 14.72%，累計前 7 月自結合併稅前盈餘 155.22 億元，年增 18.91%。因核心業務動能強勁，獲利在利息及手續費淨收益雙雙帶動下，累計前 7 月稅後盈餘 134.92 億元，續寫同期新高，年增 22.35%，每股稅後 EPS 為 1.12 元。
彰銀各項核心業務動能強勁，手續費收益持續增加，其中財富管理業務已占整體手續費收入接近 8 成，並整合高資產財富管理、信託服務與普惠金融 3 大主軸，打造涵蓋職涯累積、退休安養至世代傳承的全方位金融服務，展現百年銀行深耕財富管理之專業實力。
彰銀自 2018 年成立高資產服務團隊以來，已服務逾 1,500 位高資產客戶，整合投資理財、家族辦公室、信託規劃、資產傳承及跨境金融等專業，提供客製化財富管理方案。2026 年 3 月 26 日啟動亞資中心高雄專區分行，預期至 2026 年底高資產客戶數及資產管理規模將穩健成長，進一步提升市場競爭優勢。
在信託服務方面，彰銀以全人生信託理念導入模組化契約設計，推出安養傳富信託，透過單一契約整合多元資產與功能，串連在職累積、退休安養、風險防護與財富傳承等各階段需求，為客戶提供更具彈性與效率、橫跨全人生的長期陪伴服務。
此外，彰銀落實普惠金融，加入 TISA 基金銷售行列，推出 TISA 月月扣投資輕鬆 GO 專案，以低門檻、數位化申辦與雙零費用優惠機制，協助國人建立長期且紀律的投資習慣，為財富累積奠定堅實基礎。
彰銀表示，未來將秉持熱忱、效率、創新理念，深化數位金融應用，結合高資產服務、全人生信託與普惠投資機制，打造兼具國際視野與專業特色的財富管理平台，陪伴客戶邁向財富增值與永續傳承的新未來。
paras_en: Chang Hwa Bank (2801-TW) announced its unaudited consolidated pre-tax profit of NT$24.09 billion and consolidated net profit of NT$21.78 billion for July 2026, representing a year-on-year increase of 14.72%. The bank's unaudited consolidated pre-tax profit for the first 7 months reached NT$155.22 billion, a year-on-year increase of 18.91%. The bank's net profit for the first 7 months reached NT$134.92 billion, the highest in the same period, with a year-on-year increase of 22.35%. The bank's EPS was NT$1.12.

Chang Hwa Bank's core businesses have been performing strongly, with fee income increasing continuously. The bank's wealth management business has accounted for nearly 80% of its total fee income. The bank has integrated high-net-worth wealth management, trust services, and inclusive finance into three main axes, providing comprehensive financial services that cover career accumulation, retirement, and intergenerational succession.

Since the establishment of the high-net-worth service team in 2018, Chang Hwa Bank has served over 1,500 high-net-worth clients. The bank has integrated investment and financial planning, family office, trust planning, asset succession, and cross-border finance into its services, providing customized wealth management solutions. The bank launched the Asia Center in Kaohsiung in March 2026, and expects the number of high-net-worth clients and the scale of asset management to grow steadily by the end of 2026, further enhancing its market competitiveness.

In the trust services sector, Chang Hwa Bank has introduced a modular contract design based on the concept of lifetime trust, launching the Annuity Transmission Trust. The trust combines multiple assets and functions into a single contract, connecting the needs of different stages of life, including career accumulation, retirement, risk protection, and wealth succession, providing customers with more flexible and efficient long-term services.

In addition, Chang Hwa Bank has implemented inclusive finance by joining the TISA fund sales list, launching the TISA Monthly Deduction Investment Easy GO project. The project offers low thresholds, digitalized application, and zero-fee mechanisms, helping Taiwanese people establish long-term and disciplined investment habits, laying a solid foundation for wealth accumulation.

Chang Hwa Bank stated that it will continue to uphold its passion, efficiency, and innovative spirit, deepening the application of digital finance, combining high-net-worth services, lifetime trusts, and inclusive investment mechanisms to create a wealth management platform with international vision and professional characteristics, accompanying customers in their pursuit of wealth growth and sustainable succession in the new future.

items.title: 第三季最強四大天王曝光！下一波飆股就在這？
paras: 最近很多投資人都有同一種心情~~
前幾天看到台股短短幾個交易日大漲五千點，恨不得把資金全部押進去；但一看到指數回檔幾百點，又開始懷疑：「行情是不是結束了？是不是又要崩盤？」如果你也是這樣，那我要先告訴你一句話：「真正的大多頭，從來不是一路直線往上，而是大漲、小回、再創高」。股市真正可怕的，不是回檔，而是在回檔時，把未來會大漲的股票親手賣掉。
看懂資金流向，比每天猜漲跌重要一百倍
如果把這一波行情比喻成一場馬拉松，前面的五千點只是鳴槍起跑，現在反而才進入真正考驗投資人耐心與紀律的階段。現在的國際資金，正在發生非常微妙且巨大的轉變：
第一，美國公債殖利率開始回落。
過去殖利率維持高檔時，全球資金更願意停泊在債券市場，享受相對穩定的收益；但隨著殖利率逐步走低，市場開始重新提高對股票等風險性資產的配置意願。
第二，美元轉弱，亞洲貨幣同步轉強，新台幣表現相對突出。
匯率變化代表的不只是數字，而是國際資金正在重新配置。當台幣升值，通常代表海外資金流入增加，也讓外資回補台股的意願提升。
第三，就是外資買盤重新回到電子股。
近期市場成交量放大，電子權值股重新成為盤面主角，AI 供應鏈再度扮演領漲核心，代表資金並不是離開市場，而是開始重新集中到真正具有成長性的產業。
鑽石在哪裡？四大黃金族群精準拆解
既然知道資金正在大舉回流，那麼在這個黃金交叉點，有哪些具備真金白銀獲利能力的「鑽石」值得我們彎腰去撿？以下我幫大家鎖定了四大具備基本面與利基優勢的關鍵族群：
1. AI 供應鏈：實打實的超級循環
AI 絕非曇花一現的泡沫，而是正在加速回收投資報酬的超級循環，這股大趨勢預計會一路延續到 2030 年。

台積電 (2330-TW)： 作為全球 AI 晶片的終極推手，其 CoWoS 先進製程產能持續供不應求。受惠於全球雲端服務商（CSP）龐大且持續追加的資本支出，台積電獲利能見度極高，是多頭行情的定海神針。
日月光投控 (3711-TW)： 全球半導體封測龍頭，更是先進封裝（CoWoS 與 Fan-out）不可或缺的樞紐。隨著先進封裝營收目標邁向翻倍，公司砸重金擴展產能，強勢鎖定 AI 算力暴增下的龐大封測需求。 


2. CPO 矽光子：速度提升 10 倍的傳輸革命
當 AI 晶片效能劇增，傳統銅線傳輸已達到物理極限，必須改用「矽光子（CPO）」。加上美系客戶去中國化轉單效應，台灣廠商成為最大贏家。

聯亞 (3081-TW)： CPO 光通訊的核心指標。受惠於新一代產品認證通過並進入量產，近期營收相較去年同期呈爆發性成長 1.7 倍，強勢拉出多根漲停，成為此波 CPO 行情的領頭羊。
華星光 (4979-TW)： 作為 CPO 供應鏈第二波的核心要角，受惠於美系轉單效應與產品規格升級。公司在先進封裝與光通訊模組領域具備獨特利基，下半年營收有望隨量產啟動而迎來主升段。
汎銓 (6830-TW)： AI 與矽光子晶片研發分析平台霸主。單月營收創歷史新高且近九成來自 AI 與矽光子，已獲美系晶片大廠設立專區。手握全球光損偵測專利護城河，毛利率朝 30%~40% 回升，今明年業績將迎來大爆發。 


3. 記憶體：利空出盡的評價修復
前陣子記憶體因為融資去槓桿而重挫，但這正好創造了極低的歷史本益比。基本面上，CSP 業者為了搶奪 DDR4 產能甚至願意提供更高報價，第二波評價修復行情才剛開始。

南亞科 (2408-TW)： DRAM 指標大廠。先前股價過度修正使本益比來到歷史極低檔。隨著市況回溫及高階 DDR4、DDR5 報價看漲，公司基本面獲利預期獲得大幅上修，具備強烈的評價修復彈性。
華邦電 (2344-TW)： 受惠於雲端與邊緣 AI 需求，且具備優異的成本控管能力，展現「三綠三升」的財務底氣。在利基型記憶體出貨回溫下，下半年傳統旺季的獲利噴發速度值得期待。


4. 散熱族群：AI 心臟的冷卻守護者
AI 伺服器功耗極高，只要散熱跟不上，晶片就會降速甚至燒毀，「沒有散熱，就沒有 AI」是市場鐵律。散熱指標股近期整理完畢後紛紛大噴出，宣告主升段正式啟動。

奇鋐 (3017-TW)： 伺服器散熱解決方案的霸主。擁有從 3D VC 到水冷散熱的完整技術利基，受惠於 AI 晶片功耗大增，訂單能見度直達明年，獲利成長極具想像空間。
健策 (3653-TW)： 均熱片大廠，在先進封裝散熱組件領域擁有絕對優勢。隨著 AI 晶片出貨爆發，健策底型建構完整並順利創下新高，彰顯其在散熱金屬件中的無可替代性。
富世達 (6805-TW)： 機櫃水冷快拆件（QD）與滑軌樞紐王。受惠 GB/LPU 機櫃單櫃 QD 用量大幅飆升，伺服器營收占比上看六成，2026 年毛利率衝破 30%，EPS 年複合成長率（CAGR）超過 60%，成長動能極為剽悍。

items.title: 特斯拉打造超大Terafab晶片園區 這些個股可望受惠
items.title_en: Tesla to Build Massive Terafab Chip Complex, These Stocks May Benefit
paras: 《Seeking Alpha》報導，特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 周四 (6 日) 證實，旗下大型晶片製造園區 Terafab 將落腳美國德州 Grimes County。公司今年 4 月已在德州超級工廠（Giga Texas）北園區為研究型晶圓廠動工，並稱該設施將成為 Terafab 的前身。初期投資金額為 168 億美元。
簡單來說，Terafab 是一座規劃中的超大型半導體製造園區，由特斯拉、SpaceX(SPCX-US) 及 xAI 共同打造，目標是以前所未有的規模生產先進 AI 晶片。
Terafab 被設計成一座垂直整合的「晶片城」，將晶片設計、晶圓製造、記憶體生產、先進封裝及測試等主要製程，全都整合在同一園區內，而不是像目前產業慣例，分散於不同公司及不同廠區完成。
其目標是每年打造超過 1 太瓦 (terawatt) 的 AI 算力，供應特斯拉的電動車及 Optimus 人形機器人所需晶片，同時支援 SpaceX 與 xAI 規劃中的太空 AI 資料中心及太陽能衛星。
展望未來，馬斯克旗下企業希望藉由大規模垂直整合晶片設計與製造，大幅降低 AI 晶片成本，並縮小當前全球晶片供應不足與未來龐大需求之間的落差。
公司表示，「特斯拉與 SpaceX 所需的晶片數量，都將遠遠超過目前及未來全球的供應能力。因此，我們正打造史上最大的晶片製造設施，目標是每年生產超過 1 太瓦的 AI 算力。」
分析師初步認為，Terafab 的大規模投資可望帶動半導體設備供應鏈需求，英特爾 (INTC-US)、艾司摩爾 (ASML-US)、應用材料 (AMAT-US)、科林研發 (LRCX-US) 及科磊 (KLAC-US) 等公司，都有望成為受惠者。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) confirmed on Thursday (6th) that its massive chip manufacturing complex, Terafab, will be located in Grimes County, Texas, according to a Seeking Alpha report.
In simple terms, Terafab is a planned massive semiconductor manufacturing complex jointly developed by Tesla, SpaceX (SPCX-US), and xAI, aiming to produce advanced AI chips on an unprecedented scale.

Terafab is designed as a vertically integrated 'chip city' where chip design, wafer manufacturing, memory production, advanced packaging, and testing will be integrated within the same complex, unlike the current industry practice of dispersing these processes across different companies and facilities.

The goal is to produce over 1 terawatt of AI computing power per year to supply chips for Tesla's electric cars and Optimus humanoid robots, while also supporting SpaceX and xAI's planned space AI data center and solar satellite.

Looking ahead, Musk's companies hope to achieve significant cost reductions in AI chip production through large-scale vertical integration and bridge the gap between current global chip supply shortages and future massive demand.

The company stated, 'The number of chips required by Tesla and SpaceX will far exceed the current and future global supply capacity. Therefore, we are building the largest chip manufacturing facility in history, aiming to produce over 1 terawatt of AI computing power per year.'

Analysts believe that the massive investment in Terafab may drive demand for semiconductor equipment supply chains, benefiting companies such as Intel (INTC-US), ASML (ASML-US), Applied Materials (AMAT-US), LAM Research (LRCX-US), and KLA Corporation (KLAC-US).

items.title: 野村資產管理：結構改革與獲利復甦雙軌並進 日股重現新契機
paras: 今年以來全球金融市場在聯準會持續關注通膨，以及人工智慧算力基礎建設持續擴張的雙重浪潮下，國際資金正加速重新配置亞洲資產。野村資產管理指出，今年以來日本股市表現展現出極具韌性的結構性轉變，日經指數與東證一部指數在企業盈餘成長與外資持續流入的推動下，頻頻刷新歷史紀錄。這不僅是短期資金炒作的結果，更是日本經濟擺脫長達三十年通縮陰霾、迎來溫和通膨與薪資增長良性循環的重要里程碑，吸引全球主動型機構投資人重新檢視這塊長線投資沃土。

野村基金 (愛爾蘭系列)- 日本策略價值基金協管經理人河野光成 (Mitsunari Kawano) 表示，根據 2026 年最新季度日本央行短觀調查，日本製造業與非製造業的企業信心指標雙雙走強，銀行放款餘額與存放比的穩定攀升，更彰顯企業擴大資本支出的強烈意願。同時，在東京證交所持續推動資本效率改革的催化下，日本企業正加速透過股票回購與股利提升來優化財務結構，逐步打破過去因現金過多、低槓桿導致的股東權益報酬率折價困境。

從最新實體經濟數據來看，日本央行 2026 年最新公布的短觀調查顯示，中大型製造業與非製造業信心均創下近年新高，且基礎通膨年增率已穩健站上 2% 的政策目標，促使日銀將政策利率逐步引導至 0.5%，引領十年期日債殖利率於 1.1% 附近震盪。在產業面，全球科技巨擘於 2026 年宣告的資本支出總計增至創紀錄的 1800 億美元，刺激日本關鍵半導體高階封裝材料與測試設備的產能利用率暴增至 92% 以上。儘管東證一部指數預估本益比已回升至過去二十年的第一個四分位區間，但相較於美股標普五百指數超過 22 倍的估值，日股仍具備極高的性價比，也呼應了企業定價能力改善將進一步轉化為實質獲利增長的內部研判。

河野光成進一步指出，當前日股的核心魅力在於治理準則深化帶來的資本效率提升。旗下日本策略價值團隊不盲從大盤權重，而是透過獨創的「三角價值驗證」方法論，從資產重建價值、盈餘可持續性與特許經營壁壘三個維度深度解構企業。透過嚴密的量化篩選漏斗，在約 3800 檔日股中精選出資本回報率改善、且積極展開股份回購的優質企業，將長期的市場折價轉化為超額報酬機會，協助投資人跨越價值陷阱，掌握真正具有獲利重估底氣的產業先鋒。
綜上所述，日本投資的致勝關鍵在於精準的主動選股，而非盲目追逐指數波動。野村資產管理建議，在 2026 年的全球資產配置藍圖中，應將日股視為兼顧防禦性與成長性的核心部位。策略上建議採取金融、消費電子與先進半導體設備並重的均衡配置，積極把握治理改革帶來的重估紅利。雖然全球地緣政治與供應鏈調整仍可能帶來短期擾動，但在溫和通膨、外國直接投資湧入以及企業健全財務的強力支撐下，日股的中長期牛市格局依舊扎實。

items.title: AI及BBU訂單放量助攻 邑昇7月營收1.85億元創歷史新高
items.title_en: Yi Sheng's 7M Revenue Hits NT$185M, a New High
paras: 已加入半導體國家隊的 PCB 廠邑昇 (5291-TW) 公布最新營收資訊 ，2026 年 7 月營收達 1.85 億元創新高，月增 51.12%，年增 43.54%，1-7 月營收 8.99 億元，年增 43.54%。同時，邑昇上半年稅後淨利 3667 萬元，每股純益 0.92 元
邑昇 7 月營收創高主要受惠於 AI 應用持續快速發展，帶動周邊設備規格全面升級，高階 PCB 需求明顯增溫，其中 AI 伺服器備援電池模組（BBU）相關產品於 7 月進入放量出貨階段，成為推升單月營收創高的主要動能。
隨著 AI 伺服器朝高功率、高密度方向發展，BBU 對 PCB 在高可靠度、高層數、高散熱及高精密製程的要求同步提升，也進一步凸顯邑昇在少量多樣、高度客製化 PCB 製造的技術優勢。公司目前與國內主要客戶維持長期穩定合作關係，除持續供應既有產品外，亦同步投入多項新產品開發，為後續營運成長奠定基礎。

從產品結構來看，邑昇今年上半年 PCB 出貨仍以工業電腦應用為主要營收來源，受惠 AI 功能持續導入工控、自動化及邊緣運算設備，帶動工業電腦產品規格升級，高階 PCB 需求穩健成長。另一方面，公司近年積極布局 AI、高速運算、低軌衛星（LEO）、無人機及終端反無人機設備等高技術門檻市場，相關產品上半年營收占比已突破雙位數，預期隨客戶專案陸續放量，高毛利產品比重將持續提升，目標 2027 年高附加價值產品營收占比較目前倍數成長，進一步優化產品組合與獲利能力。
邑昇長期聚焦少量多樣、高度客製化之利基型 PCB 市場，並因應全球供應鏈重組趨勢，生產基地皆集中於台灣桃園，可有效滿足國際客戶對非紅色供應鏈及在地製造的需求。同時，吧昇已於 2025 年 10 月正式取得 AS9100 航太品質管理系統認證，代表品質管理體系已全面接軌國際航太標準，除有助於拓展低軌衛星及航太供應鏈商機，也將持續提升公司在高可靠度 PCB 市場的競爭優勢。
因應高階產品需求快速成長，邑昇龜山二期廠現已進入最後驗收階段，預計第三季末正式啟用並開始貢獻營收，新廠將整合既有 PCB 產能，導入高精密製程設備、自動化智慧產線及數位化製程管理系統，全面提升生產效率、品質管理及交期能力，為 AI、高速運算、航太及軍工等高附加價值產品提供更充足的產能支援。
paras_en: Yi Sheng (5291-TW), a PCB manufacturer that has joined the semiconductor national team, announced its latest revenue information. In July 2026, the company's revenue reached NT$1.85 billion, a new high, with a monthly increase of 51.12% and a year-over-year increase of 43.54%. The company's revenue for the first seven months of the year was NT$8.99 billion, with a year-over-year increase of 43.54%. Meanwhile, Yi Sheng's net profit after tax for the first half of the year was NT$36.67 million, with a net profit per share of NT$0.92.

Yi Sheng's 7M revenue growth was mainly driven by the rapid development of AI applications, which has led to a significant upgrade in peripheral equipment specifications, resulting in a surge in demand for high-end PCBs. The company's BBU-related products entered the mass production stage in July, becoming the main driving force behind the company's single-month revenue growth.

As AI servers move towards high-power and high-density development, BBU has raised the bar for PCBs in terms of high reliability, high layer count, high heat dissipation, and high precision processing. This has further highlighted Yi Sheng's technical advantages in producing small-batch, high-variety, and highly customized PCBs. The company currently maintains long-term stable cooperation relationships with major domestic customers, providing existing products while simultaneously investing in the development of new products to lay the foundation for future growth.

From a product structure perspective, Yi Sheng's PCB shipments in the first half of the year still relied mainly on industrial computer applications, benefiting from the continued introduction of AI functions into industrial control, automation, and edge computing equipment, driving the upgrade of industrial computer products and steady growth in high-end PCB demand. On the other hand, the company has been actively expanding into AI, high-speed computing, low-Earth orbit (LEO), unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), and terminal anti-UAV equipment markets with high technical thresholds. The related products accounted for a double-digit percentage of the company's revenue in the first half of the year, and it is expected that as customer projects are gradually put into mass production, the proportion of high-margin products will continue to rise, aiming to achieve a growth of multiple times in 2027 compared to the current year, further optimizing the product mix and profitability.

Yi Sheng has long focused on the niche market of small-batch, high-variety, and highly customized PCBs, and in response to the trend of global supply chain reorganization, all of its production bases are concentrated in Taoyuan, Taiwan, effectively meeting the needs of international customers for non-red supply chains and local manufacturing. Additionally, Yi Sheng officially obtained the AS9100 aerospace quality management system certification in October 2025, representing that the quality management system has been fully aligned with international aerospace standards. This not only helps to expand opportunities in the LEO and aerospace supply chain but also continues to enhance the company's competitive advantage in the high-reliability PCB market.

In response to the rapid growth of high-end product demand, Yi Sheng's Guaishan Phase II factory has entered the final inspection stage and is expected to be officially put into operation by the end of the third quarter, contributing to revenue. The new factory will integrate existing PCB production capacity, introduce high-precision processing equipment, automated intelligent production lines, and digitalized process management systems, comprehensively improving production efficiency, quality management, and delivery capabilities, providing more abundant production capacity support for AI, high-speed computing, aerospace, and military products with high added value.

items.title: 台普威Q2獲利翻倍、EPS 3.6元 擬買回庫藏股600張
items.title_en: TPW Energy Q2 Profit Doubles, EPS 3.6 NTD, Plans to Repurchase 600 Shares
paras: 雲豹能源 (6869-TW) 旗下儲能子公司台普威能源 (7921-TW) 召開董事會，通過 2026 年第二季財務報告、盈餘分配案及庫藏股案。受惠海外儲能相關收入大幅成長，台普威上半年合併營收達新台幣 11.09 億元，稅後淨利 1.45 億元，年增 102.9%，每股盈餘 (EPS) 為 3.6 元，獲利表現亮眼。
同時，董事會亦決議自 2026 年 8 月 6 日至 10 月 5 日辦理庫藏股買回，預計買回普通股 600 張，買回價格區間為每股 72 元至 120 元；若股價低於買回價格區間下限，公司仍將持續執行買回。買回股份將轉讓予員工，藉此強化人才激勵與團隊向心力，並展現公司對長期營運發展及企業價值的信心。
隨著海外儲能布局效益逐步顯現，台普威上半年毛利率由去年同期 11% 大幅提升至 34%，創歷史新高；營業利益達 2.12 億元，年增 93.7%，顯示海外業務成長已逐步轉化為實質獲利成果。
台普威總經理馮浩翔表示，今年上半年營運動能主要來自海外市場，其中日本市場營收達新台幣 7.89 億元，占整體營收逾 7 成。台普威近年積極拓展日本儲能市場，目前已有逾 13 座案場完成併網，2026 年預計裝置容量達 58MW / 231MWh，除持續推進高壓案件外，亦擴展至低壓及特高壓儲能市場，逐步擴大當地建置規模及收入組合。
除日本市場外，台普威近期亦啟動澳洲市場布局，目前已掌握 128MW / 292MWh 開發案量，預計於今、明兩年陸續完工。同時持續開發歐洲、北美等具成長潛力的海外市場，以台灣經驗建立跨國實績，推動海外事業成為未來營收與獲利的重要成長引擎。
在股東回饋方面，董事會通過 2025 年度盈餘分配案，每股擬配發現金股利 2.53 元，與股東共享營運成果。
展望下半年，台普威將持續推進日本及澳洲儲能專案，並積極布局 AI 資料中心 (AIDC) 等新興市場，延續「實績先行、由小到大」策略，逐步擴大應用規模，以自主 EMS、系統整合及工程建置能力，掌握 AIDC 對穩定供電與能源管理的需求。
paras_en: TPW Energy (7921-TW), a subsidiary of Cloud Leopard Energy (6869-TW), held a board meeting to approve the 2026 second-quarter financial report, profit distribution plan, and treasury stock plan. Benefiting from significant growth in overseas energy storage-related income, TPW Energy's first-half consolidated revenue reached NT$11.09 billion, net profit after tax of NT$1.45 billion, a year-on-year increase of 102.9%, and an EPS of 3.6 NTD, with outstanding performance.

The board of directors also decided to conduct a treasury stock repurchase from August 6 to October 5, 2026, with a plan to repurchase 600 common shares at a price range of NT$72 to NT$120 per share. If the stock price is below the lower limit of the price range, the company will continue to execute the repurchase. The repurchased shares will be transferred to employees to enhance talent motivation and team cohesion, and to demonstrate the company's confidence in long-term operation development and corporate value.

As the benefits of overseas energy storage layout gradually emerge, TPW Energy's first-half gross margin rose significantly from 11% in the same period last year to 34%, a new historical high. Operating profit reached NT$2.12 billion, a year-on-year increase of 93.7%, indicating that overseas business growth has gradually turned into tangible profit results.

TPW Energy's General Manager, Feng Hao-Xiang, stated that the company's revenue in the first half of the year mainly came from overseas markets, with Japan's revenue reaching NT$7.89 billion, accounting for over 7% of the company's total revenue. TPW Energy has been actively expanding the Japanese energy storage market in recent years and has completed over 13 project connections. In 2026, the company expects to install 58MW/231MWh of capacity, in addition to continuing to push high-voltage cases, it has also expanded to low-voltage and high-voltage energy storage markets, gradually expanding its local scale and income composition.

In addition to the Japanese market, TPW Energy has recently launched its layout in the Australian market, with a current development volume of 128MW/292MWh. The company expects to complete the projects in the next two years. At the same time, it continues to develop other overseas markets with growth potential, such as Europe and North America, to establish cross-border achievements with Taiwan's experience and drive overseas business to become an important engine for future revenue and profit growth.

Regarding shareholder returns, the board of directors approved the 2025 dividend distribution plan, with a proposed cash dividend of NT$2.53 per share, sharing the company's operating results with shareholders.

Looking ahead to the second half of the year, TPW Energy will continue to push forward Japanese and Australian energy storage projects and actively layout AI data centers (AIDC) and other emerging markets, continuing the 'results-driven, from small to large' strategy, gradually expanding the application scale, and mastering AIDC's demand for stable power supply and energy management with its autonomous EMS, system integration, and engineering construction capabilities.

items.title: 核心業務與手收發威！彰銀前7月賺134.92億創同期高 EPS衝上1.12元
items.title_en: Chang Hwa Bank Posts NT$134.92 Billion in Profit for First 7 Months, Highest in Same Period
paras: 彰銀 (2801-TW) 今公布 2026 年 7 月份自結合併稅前盈餘 24.09 億元，合併稅後盈餘 21.78 億元，年增 14.72%，累計前 7 月自結合併稅前盈餘 155.22 億元，年增 18.91%。因核心業務動能強勁，獲利在利息及手續費淨收益雙雙帶動下，累計前 7 月稅後盈餘 134.92 億元，續寫同期新高，年增 22.35%，每股稅後 EPS 為 1.12 元。
彰銀各項核心業務動能強勁，手續費收益持續增加，其中財富管理業務已占整體手續費收入接近 8 成，並整合高資產財富管理、信託服務與普惠金融 3 大主軸，打造涵蓋職涯累積、退休安養至世代傳承的全方位金融服務，展現百年銀行深耕財富管理之專業實力。
彰銀自 2018 年成立高資產服務團隊以來，已服務逾 1,500 位高資產客戶，整合投資理財、家族辦公室、信託規劃、資產傳承及跨境金融等專業，提供客製化財富管理方案。2026 年 3 月 26 日啟動亞資中心高雄專區分行，預期至 2026 年底高資產客戶數及資產管理規模將穩健成長，進一步提升市場競爭優勢。
在信託服務方面，彰銀以全人生信託理念導入模組化契約設計，推出安養傳富信託，透過單一契約整合多元資產與功能，串連在職累積、退休安養、風險防護與財富傳承等各階段需求，為客戶提供更具彈性與效率、橫跨全人生的長期陪伴服務。
此外，彰銀落實普惠金融，加入 TISA 基金銷售行列，推出 TISA 月月扣投資輕鬆 GO 專案，以低門檻、數位化申辦與雙零費用優惠機制，協助國人建立長期且紀律的投資習慣，為財富累積奠定堅實基礎。
彰銀表示，未來將秉持熱忱、效率、創新理念，深化數位金融應用，結合高資產服務、全人生信託與普惠投資機制，打造兼具國際視野與專業特色的財富管理平台，陪伴客戶邁向財富增值與永續傳承的新未來。
paras_en: Chang Hwa Bank (2801-TW) announced its unaudited consolidated pre-tax profit of NT$24.09 billion and consolidated net profit of NT$21.78 billion for July 2026, representing a year-on-year increase of 14.72%. The bank's unaudited consolidated pre-tax profit for the first 7 months reached NT$155.22 billion, a year-on-year increase of 18.91%. The bank's net profit for the first 7 months reached NT$134.92 billion, the highest in the same period, with a year-on-year increase of 22.35%. The bank's EPS was NT$1.12.

Chang Hwa Bank's core businesses have been performing strongly, with fee income increasing continuously. The bank's wealth management business has accounted for nearly 80% of its total fee income. The bank has integrated high-net-worth wealth management, trust services, and inclusive finance into three main axes, providing comprehensive financial services that cover career accumulation, retirement, and intergenerational succession.

Since the establishment of the high-net-worth service team in 2018, Chang Hwa Bank has served over 1,500 high-net-worth clients. The bank has integrated investment and financial planning, family office, trust planning, asset succession, and cross-border finance into its services, providing customized wealth management solutions. The bank launched the Asia Center in Kaohsiung in March 2026, and expects the number of high-net-worth clients and the scale of asset management to grow steadily by the end of 2026, further enhancing its market competitiveness.

In the trust services sector, Chang Hwa Bank has introduced a modular contract design based on the concept of lifetime trust, launching the Annuity Transmission Trust. The trust combines multiple assets and functions into a single contract, connecting the needs of different stages of life, including career accumulation, retirement, risk protection, and wealth succession, providing customers with more flexible and efficient long-term services.

In addition, Chang Hwa Bank has implemented inclusive finance by joining the TISA fund sales list, launching the TISA Monthly Deduction Investment Easy GO project. The project offers low thresholds, digitalized application, and zero-fee mechanisms, helping Taiwanese people establish long-term and disciplined investment habits, laying a solid foundation for wealth accumulation.

Chang Hwa Bank stated that it will continue to uphold its passion, efficiency, and innovative spirit, deepening the application of digital finance, combining high-net-worth services, lifetime trusts, and inclusive investment mechanisms to create a wealth management platform with international vision and professional characteristics, accompanying customers in their pursuit of wealth growth and sustainable succession in the new future.

items.title: 第三季最強四大天王曝光！下一波飆股就在這？
paras: 最近很多投資人都有同一種心情~~
前幾天看到台股短短幾個交易日大漲五千點，恨不得把資金全部押進去；但一看到指數回檔幾百點，又開始懷疑：「行情是不是結束了？是不是又要崩盤？」如果你也是這樣，那我要先告訴你一句話：「真正的大多頭，從來不是一路直線往上，而是大漲、小回、再創高」。股市真正可怕的，不是回檔，而是在回檔時，把未來會大漲的股票親手賣掉。
看懂資金流向，比每天猜漲跌重要一百倍
如果把這一波行情比喻成一場馬拉松，前面的五千點只是鳴槍起跑，現在反而才進入真正考驗投資人耐心與紀律的階段。現在的國際資金，正在發生非常微妙且巨大的轉變：
第一，美國公債殖利率開始回落。
過去殖利率維持高檔時，全球資金更願意停泊在債券市場，享受相對穩定的收益；但隨著殖利率逐步走低，市場開始重新提高對股票等風險性資產的配置意願。
第二，美元轉弱，亞洲貨幣同步轉強，新台幣表現相對突出。
匯率變化代表的不只是數字，而是國際資金正在重新配置。當台幣升值，通常代表海外資金流入增加，也讓外資回補台股的意願提升。
第三，就是外資買盤重新回到電子股。
近期市場成交量放大，電子權值股重新成為盤面主角，AI 供應鏈再度扮演領漲核心，代表資金並不是離開市場，而是開始重新集中到真正具有成長性的產業。
鑽石在哪裡？四大黃金族群精準拆解
既然知道資金正在大舉回流，那麼在這個黃金交叉點，有哪些具備真金白銀獲利能力的「鑽石」值得我們彎腰去撿？以下我幫大家鎖定了四大具備基本面與利基優勢的關鍵族群：
1. AI 供應鏈：實打實的超級循環
AI 絕非曇花一現的泡沫，而是正在加速回收投資報酬的超級循環，這股大趨勢預計會一路延續到 2030 年。

台積電 (2330-TW)： 作為全球 AI 晶片的終極推手，其 CoWoS 先進製程產能持續供不應求。受惠於全球雲端服務商（CSP）龐大且持續追加的資本支出，台積電獲利能見度極高，是多頭行情的定海神針。
日月光投控 (3711-TW)： 全球半導體封測龍頭，更是先進封裝（CoWoS 與 Fan-out）不可或缺的樞紐。隨著先進封裝營收目標邁向翻倍，公司砸重金擴展產能，強勢鎖定 AI 算力暴增下的龐大封測需求。 


2. CPO 矽光子：速度提升 10 倍的傳輸革命
當 AI 晶片效能劇增，傳統銅線傳輸已達到物理極限，必須改用「矽光子（CPO）」。加上美系客戶去中國化轉單效應，台灣廠商成為最大贏家。

聯亞 (3081-TW)： CPO 光通訊的核心指標。受惠於新一代產品認證通過並進入量產，近期營收相較去年同期呈爆發性成長 1.7 倍，強勢拉出多根漲停，成為此波 CPO 行情的領頭羊。
華星光 (4979-TW)： 作為 CPO 供應鏈第二波的核心要角，受惠於美系轉單效應與產品規格升級。公司在先進封裝與光通訊模組領域具備獨特利基，下半年營收有望隨量產啟動而迎來主升段。
汎銓 (6830-TW)： AI 與矽光子晶片研發分析平台霸主。單月營收創歷史新高且近九成來自 AI 與矽光子，已獲美系晶片大廠設立專區。手握全球光損偵測專利護城河，毛利率朝 30%~40% 回升，今明年業績將迎來大爆發。 


3. 記憶體：利空出盡的評價修復
前陣子記憶體因為融資去槓桿而重挫，但這正好創造了極低的歷史本益比。基本面上，CSP 業者為了搶奪 DDR4 產能甚至願意提供更高報價，第二波評價修復行情才剛開始。

南亞科 (2408-TW)： DRAM 指標大廠。先前股價過度修正使本益比來到歷史極低檔。隨著市況回溫及高階 DDR4、DDR5 報價看漲，公司基本面獲利預期獲得大幅上修，具備強烈的評價修復彈性。
華邦電 (2344-TW)： 受惠於雲端與邊緣 AI 需求，且具備優異的成本控管能力，展現「三綠三升」的財務底氣。在利基型記憶體出貨回溫下，下半年傳統旺季的獲利噴發速度值得期待。


4. 散熱族群：AI 心臟的冷卻守護者
AI 伺服器功耗極高，只要散熱跟不上，晶片就會降速甚至燒毀，「沒有散熱，就沒有 AI」是市場鐵律。散熱指標股近期整理完畢後紛紛大噴出，宣告主升段正式啟動。

奇鋐 (3017-TW)： 伺服器散熱解決方案的霸主。擁有從 3D VC 到水冷散熱的完整技術利基，受惠於 AI 晶片功耗大增，訂單能見度直達明年，獲利成長極具想像空間。
健策 (3653-TW)： 均熱片大廠，在先進封裝散熱組件領域擁有絕對優勢。隨著 AI 晶片出貨爆發，健策底型建構完整並順利創下新高，彰顯其在散熱金屬件中的無可替代性。
富世達 (6805-TW)： 機櫃水冷快拆件（QD）與滑軌樞紐王。受惠 GB/LPU 機櫃單櫃 QD 用量大幅飆升，伺服器營收占比上看六成，2026 年毛利率衝破 30%，EPS 年複合成長率（CAGR）超過 60%，成長動能極為剽悍。

items.title: 野村資產管理：結構改革與獲利復甦雙軌並進 日股重現新契機
paras: 今年以來全球金融市場在聯準會持續關注通膨，以及人工智慧算力基礎建設持續擴張的雙重浪潮下，國際資金正加速重新配置亞洲資產。野村資產管理指出，今年以來日本股市表現展現出極具韌性的結構性轉變，日經指數與東證一部指數在企業盈餘成長與外資持續流入的推動下，頻頻刷新歷史紀錄。這不僅是短期資金炒作的結果，更是日本經濟擺脫長達三十年通縮陰霾、迎來溫和通膨與薪資增長良性循環的重要里程碑，吸引全球主動型機構投資人重新檢視這塊長線投資沃土。

野村基金 (愛爾蘭系列)- 日本策略價值基金協管經理人河野光成 (Mitsunari Kawano) 表示，根據 2026 年最新季度日本央行短觀調查，日本製造業與非製造業的企業信心指標雙雙走強，銀行放款餘額與存放比的穩定攀升，更彰顯企業擴大資本支出的強烈意願。同時，在東京證交所持續推動資本效率改革的催化下，日本企業正加速透過股票回購與股利提升來優化財務結構，逐步打破過去因現金過多、低槓桿導致的股東權益報酬率折價困境。

從最新實體經濟數據來看，日本央行 2026 年最新公布的短觀調查顯示，中大型製造業與非製造業信心均創下近年新高，且基礎通膨年增率已穩健站上 2% 的政策目標，促使日銀將政策利率逐步引導至 0.5%，引領十年期日債殖利率於 1.1% 附近震盪。在產業面，全球科技巨擘於 2026 年宣告的資本支出總計增至創紀錄的 1800 億美元，刺激日本關鍵半導體高階封裝材料與測試設備的產能利用率暴增至 92% 以上。儘管東證一部指數預估本益比已回升至過去二十年的第一個四分位區間，但相較於美股標普五百指數超過 22 倍的估值，日股仍具備極高的性價比，也呼應了企業定價能力改善將進一步轉化為實質獲利增長的內部研判。

河野光成進一步指出，當前日股的核心魅力在於治理準則深化帶來的資本效率提升。旗下日本策略價值團隊不盲從大盤權重，而是透過獨創的「三角價值驗證」方法論，從資產重建價值、盈餘可持續性與特許經營壁壘三個維度深度解構企業。透過嚴密的量化篩選漏斗，在約 3800 檔日股中精選出資本回報率改善、且積極展開股份回購的優質企業，將長期的市場折價轉化為超額報酬機會，協助投資人跨越價值陷阱，掌握真正具有獲利重估底氣的產業先鋒。
綜上所述，日本投資的致勝關鍵在於精準的主動選股，而非盲目追逐指數波動。野村資產管理建議，在 2026 年的全球資產配置藍圖中，應將日股視為兼顧防禦性與成長性的核心部位。策略上建議採取金融、消費電子與先進半導體設備並重的均衡配置，積極把握治理改革帶來的重估紅利。雖然全球地緣政治與供應鏈調整仍可能帶來短期擾動，但在溫和通膨、外國直接投資湧入以及企業健全財務的強力支撐下，日股的中長期牛市格局依舊扎實。

items.title: 特斯拉打造超大Terafab晶片園區 這些個股可望受惠
items.title_en: Tesla to Build Massive Terafab Chip Complex, These Stocks May Benefit
paras: 《Seeking Alpha》報導，特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 周四 (6 日) 證實，旗下大型晶片製造園區 Terafab 將落腳美國德州 Grimes County。公司今年 4 月已在德州超級工廠（Giga Texas）北園區為研究型晶圓廠動工，並稱該設施將成為 Terafab 的前身。初期投資金額為 168 億美元。
簡單來說，Terafab 是一座規劃中的超大型半導體製造園區，由特斯拉、SpaceX(SPCX-US) 及 xAI 共同打造，目標是以前所未有的規模生產先進 AI 晶片。
Terafab 被設計成一座垂直整合的「晶片城」，將晶片設計、晶圓製造、記憶體生產、先進封裝及測試等主要製程，全都整合在同一園區內，而不是像目前產業慣例，分散於不同公司及不同廠區完成。
其目標是每年打造超過 1 太瓦 (terawatt) 的 AI 算力，供應特斯拉的電動車及 Optimus 人形機器人所需晶片，同時支援 SpaceX 與 xAI 規劃中的太空 AI 資料中心及太陽能衛星。
展望未來，馬斯克旗下企業希望藉由大規模垂直整合晶片設計與製造，大幅降低 AI 晶片成本，並縮小當前全球晶片供應不足與未來龐大需求之間的落差。
公司表示，「特斯拉與 SpaceX 所需的晶片數量，都將遠遠超過目前及未來全球的供應能力。因此，我們正打造史上最大的晶片製造設施，目標是每年生產超過 1 太瓦的 AI 算力。」
分析師初步認為，Terafab 的大規模投資可望帶動半導體設備供應鏈需求，英特爾 (INTC-US)、艾司摩爾 (ASML-US)、應用材料 (AMAT-US)、科林研發 (LRCX-US) 及科磊 (KLAC-US) 等公司，都有望成為受惠者。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) confirmed on Thursday (6th) that its massive chip manufacturing complex, Terafab, will be located in Grimes County, Texas, according to a Seeking Alpha report.
In simple terms, Terafab is a planned massive semiconductor manufacturing complex jointly developed by Tesla, SpaceX (SPCX-US), and xAI, aiming to produce advanced AI chips on an unprecedented scale.

Terafab is designed as a vertically integrated 'chip city' where chip design, wafer manufacturing, memory production, advanced packaging, and testing will be integrated within the same complex, unlike the current industry practice of dispersing these processes across different companies and facilities.

The goal is to produce over 1 terawatt of AI computing power per year to supply chips for Tesla's electric cars and Optimus humanoid robots, while also supporting SpaceX and xAI's planned space AI data center and solar satellite.

Looking ahead, Musk's companies hope to achieve significant cost reductions in AI chip production through large-scale vertical integration and bridge the gap between current global chip supply shortages and future massive demand.

The company stated, 'The number of chips required by Tesla and SpaceX will far exceed the current and future global supply capacity. Therefore, we are building the largest chip manufacturing facility in history, aiming to produce over 1 terawatt of AI computing power per year.'

Analysts believe that the massive investment in Terafab may drive demand for semiconductor equipment supply chains, benefiting companies such as Intel (INTC-US), ASML (ASML-US), Applied Materials (AMAT-US), LAM Research (LRCX-US), and KLA Corporation (KLAC-US).

items.title_en: Morgan Stanley Turns Bullish on Memory Stocks: Worst Correction Over, AI Demand to Drive Next Wave of Growth, Favoring Samsung and SK Hynix
paras: 摩根士丹利最新發布的記憶體產業研究報告指出，記憶體產業今年以來經歷的大幅修正已接近尾聲，市場焦點將逐步由價格循環轉向資本回饋，包括股票回購、自由現金流及長期供貨協議 (LTA) 等因素，有望成為下一波推升股價的重要催化劑。被喻為「空頭」代言人的分析師 Shawn Kim 認為，目前估值已提供具吸引力的戰術性進場時機，近期修正僅是 AI 超級循環中的一段正常波動。
報告指出，摩根士丹利早在 7 月初便提醒，記憶體股因 DRAM 價格漲勢即將放緩，以及市場持倉過度集中，可能出現短期回調。此後雖然市場對 AI 資本支出及 AI 需求仍維持樂觀，但也開始注意到 4Q26 起 DRAM 價格增幅趨緩、庫存逐步回升及新增供給增加等現象，使市場對後續獲利驚喜有所保留。不過，分析師認為，經過近期修正後，記憶體股估值已明顯改善，未來資本回報政策可望加速。

摩根士丹利表示，AI 帶動的需求與傳統記憶體景氣循環並不衝突。雖然 DRAM 價格同比增速可能已見高點，但此次 AI 建置周期規模遠超歷史，價格年增幅一度高達 700%，約為歷史高峰的 7 倍。DRAM 已成為 AI 基礎建設的重要瓶頸之一，但目前市場對相關個股僅給予約 3 倍未來 12 個月本益比 (NTM P/E)，幾乎沒有反映長期成長溢價。報告認為，若投資人開始相信 AI 將延長產業獲利周期，估值倍數仍有擴張空間。
針對個別企業，摩根士丹利維持三星電子 (Samsung Electronics) 及 SK 海力士 (SK hynix) 目標價不變，但調整獲利預估。其中，SK 海力士 2026 年每股盈餘 (EPS) 預估上調 13%，反映第二季資產處分收益；三星電子則因消費性電子業務疲弱，2026 年 EPS 預估下修 10%，2027 年至 2028 年預測則僅小幅調整。
報告認為，記憶體產業將自 2026 年第四季進入周期後段，未來企業將更重視資本回饋、長期供貨協議 (LTA)、穩定獲利能力及自由現金流表現，而非依賴價格快速上漲帶來的營運槓桿。近期獲利預估修正幅度已明顯降溫，顯示最悲觀時期可能已經過去。
產業調查顯示，3Q26 DRAM 合約價格於初期交易約季增 15%，略低於摩根士丹利原先預估的 20%；3Q26 NAND 價格則約季增 20%。隨著 4Q26 價格漲幅趨緩，客戶提前備貨意願有所下降，但更多產能預料將由消費性產品轉向企業級 SSD(eSSD)，配合 AI 伺服器需求持續成長，可望消化新增供給。
報告進一步指出，目前市場已充分反映未來 12 個月 EPS 成長放緩風險，但 AI 帶動的需求更可能屬於結構性改變，而非單純周期循環。因此，以過去周期股的估值方式評價記憶體產業，未必仍然適用；未來若企業積極提高股東回報，將有助市場重新評價整體產業。

摩根士丹利最後維持長線樂觀看法，認為 AI 資本支出、Agentic AI 快速發展，以及三星電子與 SK 海力士 2027 年獲利可望成長 25% 至 50%，均將支撐產業基本面。報告估計，兩家公司目標價相較目前股價仍隱含超過 60% 的上行空間。短期而言，7 月大幅平倉後，市場追價資金已重新回流，預料仍將偏好 AI 資本支出受惠最大的 DRAM 及利基型記憶體，包括 DDR4 與 SLC NAND，而非記憶體模組廠商。
paras_en: Morgan Stanley's latest research report on the memory industry states that the significant correction experienced by the industry this year is nearing its end. The market's focus will shift from price cycles to capital returns, including stock buybacks, free cash flow, and long-term supply agreements (LTA), which are expected to become key catalysts for the next wave of stock price growth. Analyst Shawn Kim believes that current valuations provide an attractive opportunity for tactical entry, and the recent correction is just a normal fluctuation within the AI super cycle.

The report notes that Morgan Stanley warned in early July that memory stocks might experience a short-term correction due to the impending slowdown in DRAM price growth and overly concentrated market positions. Although the market remains optimistic about AI capital expenditures and demand, it has also begun to notice the slowing growth of DRAM prices starting from 4Q26, the gradual increase in inventory, and the rise in new supply, leading to a more cautious outlook on future earnings. However, the analyst believes that after the recent correction, memory stock valuations have improved significantly, and future capital return policies are expected to accelerate.

Morgan Stanley states that AI-driven demand does not conflict with traditional memory industry cycles. Although the year-over-year growth rate of DRAM prices may have peaked, the scale of this AI construction cycle far exceeds historical levels, with price growth reaching 700% at one point, approximately seven times the historical peak. DRAM has become a crucial bottleneck in AI infrastructure, but the market currently only gives related stocks a price-to-earnings ratio (NTM P/E) of around 3 times, barely reflecting long-term growth premiums. The report believes that if investors start to believe that AI will extend the industry's profit cycle, valuation multiples still have room for expansion.

Regarding individual companies, Morgan Stanley maintains its target prices for Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix but adjusts its earnings estimates. SK Hynix's 2026 EPS estimate is revised upward by 13% to reflect the gains from asset disposals in the second quarter, while Samsung Electronics' 2026 EPS estimate is revised downward by 10% due to weak consumer electronics business, with only minor adjustments to its 2027 and 2028 forecasts.

The report believes that the memory industry will enter the late cycle from the fourth quarter of 2026, and companies will focus more on capital returns, long-term supply agreements (LTA), stable profitability, and free cash flow performance rather than relying on rapid price increases for operational leverage. The recent earnings estimate revisions have significantly cooled down, indicating that the most pessimistic period may have passed.

Industry surveys show that 3Q26 DRAM contract prices rose by around 15% in initial trading, slightly lower than Morgan Stanley's original estimate of 20%; 3Q26 NAND prices rose by approximately 20%. As the price growth slows down in 4Q26, customers' willingness to stock up in advance has decreased, but more capacity is expected to shift from consumer products to enterprise-level SSDs (eSSD) to meet the growing demand for AI servers, which can absorb new supply.

The report further points out that the market has already fully reflected the risk of slowing EPS growth over the next 12 months, but AI-driven demand is more likely to represent a structural change rather than a simple cyclical fluctuation. Therefore, evaluating the memory industry using the valuation methods of past cyclical stocks may no longer be applicable; if companies actively increase shareholder returns in the future, it will help the market reevaluate the entire industry.

Morgan Stanley maintains its long-term optimistic outlook, believing that AI capital expenditures, the rapid development of Agentic AI, and the expected 25% to 50% growth in Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix's earnings in 2027 will support the industry's fundamentals. The report estimates that the target prices of the two companies still imply more than 60% upside potential compared to current stock prices. In the short term, after the significant unwinding in July, market funds have flowed back in and are expected to continue favoring DRAM and niche memory types, such as DDR4 and SLC NAND, that benefit most from AI capital expenditures, rather than memory module manufacturers.

items.title: AMD收購AI晶片新創Taalas 專用晶片號稱比GPU快數千倍
items.title_en: AMD Acquires AI Chip Startup Taalas, Claims Its Chips Are Thousands of Times Faster Than GPUs
paras: 《CNBC》報導，AMD(AMD-US)周四 (6 日) 宣布已達成協議收購加拿大 AI 晶片新創 Taalas。該公司專注於 AI 推論晶片，其加速器並非通用型設計，而是針對單一 AI 模型量身打造。
AMD 正依靠旗下 GPU 帶動資料中心業務成長，隨著雲端服務業者持續搶購先進 AI 晶片，GPU 仍是主要成長動能。但隨著生成式 AI 熱潮即將邁入第四年，市場逐漸發現，GPU 並非適用於所有 AI 工作負載。
雖然 Taalas 的設計犧牲了晶片的通用性，但該公司表示，其技術可打造成本更低的晶片，並在特定模型上，以比傳統 GPU 快數千倍的速度完成推論。
AMD 發言人拒絕透露此次交易金額。Taalas 自 2023 年成立以來，已累計募得 2.19 億美元創投資金。
此次收購距離輝達 (Nvidia)(NVDA-US) 斥資 200 億美元收購高效能 AI 晶片設計公司 Groq 相關資產僅約七個多月，也是輝達歷來規模最大的收購案。
Taalas 目前推出的晶片可運行 Meta(META-US)旗下 Llama 3.1 小型版本，公司也正開發可支援更大型、更先進模型的晶片。其晶片採用台積電 (TSM-US) 較舊的製程生產，並在晶片上搭載高速 SRAM 記憶體。
Taalas 執行長 Ljubisa Bajic 在公司網站表示，「我們打造了一個平台，可以將任何 AI 模型轉換為專屬矽晶片。從收到一個過去從未見過的新模型開始，只需要兩個月，就能將它實現在硬體上。」
像 Taalas 與 Groq 這類替代性 AI 晶片，對於「低延遲」應用尤其重要，因為這類應用十分重視 AI 模型首次回應的速度。
AMD 執行長蘇姿丰 7 月在產品發表會上表示，「我一直相信，晶片並不存在一體適用的解決方案。」她也指出，AMD 仍預期 GPU 將占 AI 晶片市場的大部分比重，因為 GPU 具足夠彈性，可支援不斷推出的新 AI 模型。
GPU 需求已推升輝達成為全球市值最高企業，市值超過 5 兆美元。
這項收購也反映出，領先 GPU 製造商愈來愈重視提供整合式 AI 系統，而非僅銷售單一處理器。AMD 近期已開始向包括 Meta 及微軟 (MSFT-US) 在內的客戶出貨 Helios，這是 AMD 首款與輝達整合式 AI 伺服器機櫃競爭的機櫃級產品。
AMD 表示，未來將把 Taalas 的晶片與技術納入產品藍圖，整合至包括 CPU 及 Instinct GPU 等系統中。
此外，AMD 也持續布局其他 AI 加速器。今年 7 月，公司宣布與 Cerebras 合作，預計今年稍晚將其 AI 晶片整合至系統中。
AMD 近年來積極透過收購，補足打造 Helios 機櫃所需的各項技術與零組件。2024 年，AMD 以 6.65 億美元收購 AI 模型開發商 Silo AI，並以 49 億美元收購 ZT Systems，後者提供了機櫃級產品的技術基礎。去年，AMD 也收購多家小型 AI 公司，包括專注於推論軟體的 MK1。
paras_en: AMD (AMD-US) announced on Thursday (6th) that it has reached an agreement to acquire Canadian AI chip startup Taalas. The company focuses on AI inference chips, with accelerators that are not general-purpose designs, but rather tailored to a single AI model.

AMD relies on its GPUs to drive data center business growth, as cloud service providers continue to buy advanced AI chips. However, as the generative AI craze is about to enter its fourth year, the market is finding that GPUs are not applicable to all AI workloads.

Although Taalas' design sacrifices the chip's generality, the company claims that its technology can produce lower-cost chips and complete inference on specific models thousands of times faster than traditional GPUs.
An AMD spokesperson refused to disclose the transaction amount. Taalas has raised $2.19 billion in venture capital since its inception in 2023.
This acquisition comes just over seven months after NVIDIA (NVDA-US) spent $200 billion to acquire Groq's high-performance AI chip design assets. It is NVIDIA's largest acquisition to date.

Taalas' current chips can run Meta's (META-US) Llama 3.1 small version, and the company is developing chips that can support larger and more advanced models. Its chips are produced using TSMC's (TSM-US) older process and feature high-speed SRAM memory.

Taalas CEO Ljubisa Bajic said on the company's website, "We've built a platform that can convert any AI model into a custom silicon chip. From receiving a new model that's never been seen before, we can get it running on hardware in just two months."
Companies like Taalas and Groq are particularly important for "low-latency" applications, which prioritize the speed of the AI model's first response.

AMD CEO Lisa Su said at a product launch event in July, "I've always believed that there is no one-size-fits-all solution for chips." She also noted that AMD still expects GPUs to dominate the AI chip market, as GPUs are flexible enough to support new AI models.
GPU demand has propelled NVIDIA to become the world's most valuable company, with a market value of over $5 trillion.

This acquisition also reflects the leading GPU manufacturers' growing emphasis on providing integrated AI systems rather than just selling individual processors. AMD has recently begun shipping Helios to customers including Meta and Microsoft (MSFT-US), which is its first product to compete with NVIDIA's integrated AI server racks.
AMD said it will integrate Taalas' chips and technology into its product roadmap, incorporating them into systems including CPUs and Instinct GPUs.
In addition, AMD continues to lay out other AI accelerators. In July, the company announced a partnership with Cerebras, with plans to integrate its AI chips into systems later this year.

AMD has been actively acquiring companies to fill the gaps needed to build Helios. In 2024, AMD acquired Silo AI for $665 million and ZT Systems for $4.9 billion, which provided the technology foundation for its server-level products. Last year, AMD also acquired several small AI companies, including MK1, which focuses on inference software.

items.title: OpenAI宣布：免費用戶與ChatGPT文字互動不再受到限制
items.title_en: OpenAI Announces Removal of Interaction Limits for Free ChatGPT Users
paras: OpenAI 周四（6 日）宣布，隨著熱門人工智慧（AI）應用 ChatGPT 最新更新，免費用戶與聊天機器人的文字互動將不再受到限制。
免費用戶的默認模型也將更新為 GPT‑5.6 Luna。即便是 GPT-5.6 系列中的輕量版模型，Luna 的表現依然優於目前免費用戶的默認模型 GPT-5.5 Instant。
免費用戶以及每月 8 美元 Go 套餐訂閱者還可以使用新的「思考」按鈕，該按鈕旨在讓人工智慧花更多時間推理，從而回答更複雜的問題。
儘管文字聊天已經能做到「免費暢聊」，但文件上傳、圖片生成、語音對話等更加消耗算力的對話仍會受到限制。這些更新預期從下周開始發布。
OpenAI 的最新動向或許正在展示人們使用 AI 的最新趨勢——愈發聚焦於最強大模型在實際工作流中的推理產出，純粹聊天消耗的算力已經能「免費」。
上月底 OpenAI 宣布下調 GPT 5.6 家族中兩款模型的價格，其中 GPT-5.6 Luna 下調 80%，GPT-5.6 Terra 下調 20%。這兩款模型距離發布剛剛過去三周。
Luna 是 GPT-5.6 系列中速度最快、成本最低的版本，最新價格降至每百萬輸入詞元 0.20 美元，每百萬輸出詞元 1.20 美元，此前分別為 1 美元和 6 美元。
中階模型 Terra 的輸入詞元價格降至每百萬 2 美元，輸出詞元價格將降至每百萬 12 美元，此前分別為 2.50 美元和 15 美元。最強的 GPT-5.6 Sol 價格不變，每百萬詞元輸入和輸出價格分別為 5 美元和 30 美元。
paras_en: OpenAI announced on Thursday (6th) that, following the latest update of the popular artificial intelligence (AI) application ChatGPT, free users will no longer have their text interactions with chatbots restricted.
Free users' default models will also be updated to GPT-5.6 Luna, which outperforms the current default model GPT-5.5 Instant, even in its lightweight version.
Free users and those subscribed to the $8 per month Go plan will also be able to use the new 'think' button, designed to allow AI to spend more time reasoning and answer more complex questions.
Although text chat has already reached 'free flow', file uploads, image generation, and voice conversations, which consume more computational power, will still be restricted.
These updates are expected to be released next week.

OpenAI's latest moves may be showcasing the latest trend in AI usage - a growing focus on the most powerful models' reasoning output in actual workflows, as the computational power consumed by pure chat has already become 'free'.
Last month, OpenAI announced a price cut for two models in the GPT 5.6 family, with GPT-5.6 Luna cut by 80% and GPT-5.6 Terra cut by 20%. These two models were released just three weeks ago.

Luna is the fastest and lowest-cost version of the GPT-5.6 series, with the latest price reduced to $0.20 per million input tokens and $1.20 per million output tokens, down from $1 and $6 respectively.

items.title: Fed穆薩林挺升息！不應為AI生產力容忍高通膨
items.title_en: Fed Musalem Pushes Rate Hike! Should Not Tolerate High Inflation for AI‑Driven Productivity
paras: 聖路易聯邦準備銀行總裁穆薩林 (Alberto Musalem) 周四 (5 日) 加入多名官員支持 7 月升息的行列，表示在當前環境下，貨幣政策的首要任務是對潛在通膨形成實質的抑制效果，而非容忍當前較高的通膨，只為追求未來生產力成長。
聯準會 (Fed) 在 7 月 28 日至 29 日會議決議維持利率不變，但有三位決策官員投下反對票，主張應升息。另有多位官員近期也表示，若不及早採取行動，通膨恐將更加頑強，Fed 未來可能必須升息。
穆薩林今年沒有聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 投票權，但他表示自己在 7 月會議上主張將聯邦基金利率調高 1 碼 (25 個基點)。他也表示，會後美國公債遭拋售，再次凸顯維持 Fed 公信力的重要性。
穆薩林指出，支持升息的主要原因是，如果貨幣政策維持目前水準，未來一年左右通膨持續高於 Fed 2% 目標的機率相當高。他還表示，現在就採取行動的另一個理由是，「提早進行循序漸進的小幅升息，比日後被迫採取更劇烈的利率調整，更不具干擾性、成本也更低。」

AI 有助生產力 但不能拿來當容忍通膨的理由

部分經濟學家及 Fed 主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 認為，人工智慧 (AI) 有望提升生產力，並在長期紓解通膨壓力。不過，華許在 7 月會後坦言，相關效益何時顯現仍具高度不確定性。
穆薩林表示，具限制性的貨幣政策雖然可能拖慢創新及生產力成長，但 Fed 不能把市場對其控制通膨能力的信心視為理所當然。
他警告：「如果市場認為央行願意容忍高於目標的通膨，只因寄望未來生產力大幅提升，將危及通膨預期的錨定。一旦公信力流失，重建代價將非常高。」
美國本周五將公布最新就業報告，下周則將公布新一輪通膨數據。穆薩林表示，美國經濟近月來依然展現韌性，勞動市場已趨於穩定，就業人數持續穩健成長，失業率也維持在接近長期均衡水準。
paras_en: St. Louis Federal Reserve Bank President Alberto Musalem joined several officials on Thursday (the 5th) in supporting a July rate hike, saying that in the current environment the primary task of monetary policy is to exert a real restraining effect on underlying inflation rather than tolerate the presently elevated inflation simply to chase future productivity growth.

The Fed’s July 28‑29 meeting resolved to keep rates unchanged, but three voting members cast dissenting votes urging a hike. Several other officials have recently warned that without early action inflation could become more entrenched, forcing the Fed to raise rates later.

Musalem does not have a vote on this year’s Federal Open Market Committee, yet he said he advocated a one‑point (25‑basis‑point) increase in the federal funds rate at the July meeting. He also noted that Treasury bonds were sold off after the meeting, underscoring the importance of preserving the Fed’s credibility.

He explained that the main reason to support a hike is that, if policy stays at current levels, the odds are high that inflation will remain above the Fed’s 2% target for roughly the next year. He added that acting now with a modest, gradual increase is less disruptive and cheaper than being forced later to make a more aggressive adjustment.

AI can boost productivity but should not be used as a justification for tolerating inflation. Some economists and former Fed chair Kevin Warsh see AI as a potential long‑term productivity driver that could ease inflation pressures, but Warsh admitted after the July meeting that the timing of any benefits remains highly uncertain.
Musalem said that while restrictive policy may slow innovation and productivity growth, the Fed cannot take market confidence in its inflation‑controlling ability for granted.

He warned, “If the market believes the central bank will tolerate inflation above target because it hopes for a big future productivity jump, it will jeopardize the anchoring of inflation expectations. Once credibility is lost, the cost of rebuilding it will be very high.”

The United States will release its latest jobs report on Friday and new inflation data next week. Musalem noted that the U.S. economy has remained resilient in recent months, the labor market has stabilized, employment continues to grow steadily, and the unemployment rate remains near its long‑term equilibrium level.

items.title: 預測平台Kalshi交易者：標普年底有很高機率衝破8000點 站上8200機率達三分之一
items.title_en: Forecast platform Kalshi traders: S&P has a high chance of breaking 8,000 points by year‑end, odds of reaching 8,200 about one‑third
paras: 預測交易平台 Kalshi 最新合約顯示，交易員押注標普 500 指數今年收盤站上 8000 點的機率約 66%。
Kalshi 合約以 Google Finance 收盤價結算，投機者另押注今年觸及 8200 點機率約 33%。
驅動標普近日連漲的催化劑包括美伊緊張降溫、美企 Q2 財報普遍擊敗預期及 Leopold Aschenbrenner 旗下「態勢感知基金」瀕臨清算釋出再配置資金。
市場前兩個月曾大幅減持 AI 成長股，指數靠輪動至金融、工業與公用事業掩蓋內部分化，但 AI 算力鏈回穩後，寬基 ETF 再次由科技權值帶頭。
多數賣方不把 6-7 月整理視為 AI 牛市終結。Truist 首席市場策略師 Keith Lerner 直言，企業獲利上修、美國經濟具韌性、市場廣度改善，「這種環境通常不是牛市尾聲」。
Kalshi 的 66% 機率雖非機構共識，但反映散戶與量化資金對「獲利驅動 + 利率回落」組合的定價。若 10 年期美債殖利率穩住 4.7% 下方、聯準會 (Fed) 年內不重啟升息，8000 點將從情緒目標變成可結算路徑。
paras_en: The latest contract on the prediction‑trading platform Kalshi shows that traders are betting the probability that the S&P 500 will close above 8,000 points this year is about 66%.
Kalshi contracts settle at the Google Finance closing price, and speculators also wager the probability of hitting 8,200 points this year at roughly 33%.

Catalysts driving the recent rally in the S&P include a cooling of U.S.–Iran tensions, U.S. companies' Q2 earnings generally beating expectations, and the near‑liquidation of Leopold Aschenbrenner’s “Situational Awareness Fund,” which is releasing capital for reallocation.

In the first two months, the market sharply reduced exposure to AI growth stocks, with the index rotating into financials, industrials and utilities to mask internal divergence, but after the AI compute chain stabilized, broad‑based ETFs again led the rally with tech weighting.

Most sell‑side analysts do not view the June‑July consolidation as the end of the AI bull market. Truist chief market strategist Keith Lerner said outright that corporate profit upgrades, a resilient U.S. economy, and improving market breadth mean “this kind of environment is usually not the tail end of a bull market.”

Kalshi’s 66% probability is not an institutional consensus, but it reflects retail and quantitative capital pricing the “profit‑driven + rate‑cut” combination. If the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield holds below 4.7% and the Fed does not restart rate hikes this year, 8,000 points will shift from a sentiment target to a realizable path.
